text:
micah: Quick sketch for the benchmark narrative we should ship with the launch — trying to keep it audience-first. TL;DR: show where Redwood sits on speed vs $/token, then a short tail-latency story, and a clear deployment-cost breakdown with actionable levers. Asking for quick takes and who can own visuals/data.@design @data-team

arya: 👍 like the 3-panel arc. Strong preference to call out 'predictable SLOs' as a primary hook for enterprise buyers — they care more about variance than median. Also: include a small side callout for quantization/throughput tradeoffs.

kate: For social and hero slide we should translate charts into 1-2 bold claims + supporting microcopy. Example: "Same quality, 10x lower infra $ for high-throughput apps" with a tiny scatter imaged behind it. I can do two hero variations: "speed-first" and "cost-first".

sam: Need to lock the measurement methodology before we publish. Questions: which models/seq lengths, batch sizes, and regions? Also we should surface sample size and p95/p99 windows. Suggest we add an appendix slide describing the harness and a short reproducibility checklist. Quick snippet for the chart data format we can use for the viz pipeline:```csv
model,mode,seq_len,tokens,latency_ms,tail95_ms,cost_per_1m_tokens_usd
redwood-hosted,gen,512,100000,45,120,1500
redwood-dedicated,gen,512,100000,30,90,1200
open-vanilla,gen,512,100000,70,200,2200
```

jamie: Routing & CTA thoughts — for webinar: lead funnel should be tiered. Self-serve CTA + benchmarking kit download for SMB; "book a dedicated demo" with enterprise form + SLA checklist for larger accounts. Also propose a short interactive demo: push load to hosted endpoint and failover to dedicated/private to show graceful degradation.

bench-bot: benchmark run 2026-03-18 14:12 UTC posted. Summary: 3 models, 3 seq-lens, 10k samples each. Raw artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/launch/weight-2026-03-18.zip (internal).

micah: Great — next steps: (1) @data-team finalize methodology + provide CSVs by EOD tomorrow (sam owns), (2) @design create hero + two slide variants (kate owns), (3) @growth draft two social hooks (speed-first/cost-first) and 1 webinar outline (micah+jamie). I'll assemble a short appendix with methodology and reproducibility notes. If we can get visuals by Thursday we can lock copy and rehearsal for next week's webinar. Anything I'm missing? :eyes:

arya: Can we also call out fallback policies / expected user impact (e.g., 2.5x fewer 99th percentile tail events for routed requests)? That helps ops teams internalize the value.

sam: noted — will include p50/p95/p99 and delta vs baseline, plus a short note on measurement noise.

kate: I'll mock up slides and a 280px hero image for LinkedIn — will drop drafts in #marketing-visuals.

micah: Perfect — thanks all. I'll convert this thread into a small brief and assign tasks in Notion.
